title: [Suite autour de Teichmüller dont] Teichmülleries, 1981-1982 : notes manuscrites (1981-1983, s.d.), lettres (1981, s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
H (called ST_{1,1} at the bottom of the page) is the Artin braid group B_3. It is the mapping-class / Teichmüller fundamental group of the torus with one hole, a central extension of SL(2,Z) = Γ_{1,1}. The generators are two Dehn twists ε_0, ε_1 with the braid relation ε0ε1ε0 = ε1ε0ε1. From them one sets σ = ε0ε1ε0 (the Garside element Δ), ρ = ρ_0 = (ε1ε0)^{-1}, ρ_1 = (ε0ε1)^{-1}, and further ρ'_i. The previous pages tabulate presentations of H in various pairs of generators; this page records their symmetries and selects the essential ones.

(1) Two involutive automorphisms of H generate the symmetries of these presentations.
- g ↦ ǧ sends ε_i ↦ ε_i^{-1}. It then sends σ ↦ σ^{-1}, ρ_0 ↦ ρ_1^{-1} and ρ_1 ↦ ρ_0^{-1}. This is the orientation-reversing 'mirror' automorphism, which is outer.
- g ↦ g* = int(σ) swaps ε_0 and ε_1, swaps ρ_0 and ρ_1, and fixes σ.
Centering on σ gives a binary symmetry, since σ² is central.

(2) Centering instead on ρ gives a ternary symmetry, since ρ³ is central (indeed ρ^{-3} = σ²). Define ε_∞ = ρ(ε_1) = ρ²(ε_0) = ε0^{-1}ε1ε0. Then int(ρ) permutes ε_0, ε_1, ε_∞ cyclically.
- These are the three Dehn twists on the edges of a Farey triangle: curves of slopes 0, 1, ∞ on the one-holed torus.
- Each pair satisfies the braid relation. The corresponding half-turns are σ_∞ = σ = ε0ε1ε0, σ_0 = ε1ε∞ε1 and σ_1 = ε0ε∞ε0.
- One has ρ^{-1} = ε1ε0 = ε∞ε1 = ε0ε∞.
- The reversed products (ε0ε1)^{-1} = ρ_1, (ε1ε∞)^{-1} and (ε∞ε0)^{-1} are the three distinct conjugates σ_i(ρ) = ρ^k(ρ_1).

(3) Conclusion: the essential generators are ε_0, ε_1, σ, ρ together with ω = ρ^{-3} = σ^{-2}, which generates the centre. The four principal generating systems are (ε0,ε1), (ε0,σ)~(ε1,σ), (ε0,ρ)~(ε1,ρ) and (σ,ρ). The next page gives their one- or two-relator presentations, ending with the classical ⟨σ,ρ | σ² = ρ^{-3}⟩. Imposing ω² = 1 recovers SL(2,Z).

Purpose: build a clean 'formulaire' for the genus-1 piece of the Teichmüller tower (Esquisse programme). This is the building block whose generators and relations, and whose action of Gal(Q̄/Q) / GT, are to be controlled.
errors: No mathematical errors found. All identities check, for example ρε0ρ^{-1} = ε1, ε∞ = ε0^{-1}ε1ε0, and ε∞ε1 = ε0ε∞ = ε1ε0.
Minor point: the labels σ_0, σ_1 for the conjugates ρ^kσρ^{-k} differ from σ, while σ_∞ = σ, as Grothendieck marks with '||σ'. This is consistent, not an error.

The marginal label for the first involution is ambiguous. As written (ε_i ↦ ε_i^{-1}) it is an automorphism, an outer one, not an anti-automorphism; composing it with inversion would give the anti-automorphism ε_i ↦ ε_i.

ideas.what: B_3 as the Teichmüller (mapping class) group of the one-holed torus, a central extension of SL(2,Z), with generators the Dehn twists ε0, ε1
ideas.modern_name: B_3 ≅ Mod(Σ_{1,1}^b), the universal central extension of PSL(2,Z) (up to finite index)
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme (discussion of T_{1,1} and the Teichmüller tower), in general terms

ideas.what: Symmetries of the presentations: the mirror automorphism ε_i ↦ ε_i^{-1} and conjugation by Δ = σ swapping ε0 and ε1
ideas.modern_name: Outer (mirror) automorphism of B_3 and the Garside inner automorphism

ideas.what: Ternary symmetry: int(ρ) cyclically permutes the three Dehn twists ε0, ε1, ε∞ on the slopes of a Farey triangle, with ρ^{-1} = ε1ε0 = ε∞ε1 = ε0ε∞
ideas.modern_name: Order-3 (mod centre) rotation of the Farey triangle; the ε0, ε1, ε∞ symmetric presentation of B_3

ideas.what: The four principal generating systems and their presentations, ending with ⟨σ,ρ | σ² = ρ^{-3}⟩, centre generated by ω
ideas.modern_name: Standard presentations of B_3 / trefoil knot group; SL(2,Z) = B_3/⟨ω²⟩

deep.surprise_reason: Careful but entirely classical bookkeeping on B_3 / SL(2,Z): presentations, central element, mirror and Garside automorphisms, and the Farey-triangle triple of twists. It is preparatory material for the genus-1 Teichmüller 'formulaire', with nothing new to a specialist.
transcription_corrections: The parenthetical under 'g ↦ ǧ' appears to read '(automorphisme ext.)', i.e. outer automorphism, rather than '(antiautomorphisme)'; 'automorphisme ext.' would also match the mathematics.
In the list of generating systems, '(ε0,σ[?])' is clearly '(ε0,σ) ↔ (ε1,σ)'.
The vertical marginal note at bottom right probably reads 'les quatre syst. de générateurs principaux de ST_{11}' (four systems are listed), not 'les gén. des syst. de générateurs principaux'.
'symétrie binaire (σ² ∈ Cent(H)) déf' — the 'déf' is placed above, as a superscript marking a definition.
